items.item: A breadcrumb leads back to the contracts list and ends with the contract number, and the header shows the contract number, vendor name, a status badge with text, and at most four key fields (such as value, start and end date)
items.evidence: contract-view.tsx: Breadcrumb 'Contracts' (href /contracts) > BreadcrumbPage {contract.id} (screenshot: Contracts > HĐ-2026-0187). Header shows id, 'Active' StatusBadge with icon and text, and a dl with four fields: Vendor, Contract value, Term, Renewal notice by.

items.item: The header has one primary action (such as "Renew contract") and puts other actions such as edit or terminate in a secondary or overflow position
items.evidence: Single default Button 'Start renewal'; a '...' DropdownMenu (aria-label 'More actions for contract ...') holds Create amendment, Download signed PDF, Duplicate as draft and, after a separator, destructive 'Terminate contract'. Audit headerPrimaryActions: 1.

items.item: Vendor contacts show each person's name and role, with email as a `mailto:` link and phone as a `tel:` link, and the primary contact is marked with text
items.evidence: ContactsPanel table columns Name, Role, Email, Phone; <a href={`mailto:${p.email}`}>, <a href={`tel:${p.tel}`}> (E.164); primary shows <Badge>Primary</Badge> text.

items.item: Payment milestones show the due date, amount and status, with amounts right-aligned in tabular figures and formatted as currency, and the milestones are ordered with overdue and due-soon ones first
items.evidence: PaymentsPanel: Due date, 'Amount (VND)' with text-right tabular-nums using Intl vi-VN (currency named in header, symbol not repeated per cell; totals line uses formatMoney with currency style), Status badge. sortMilestones ranks overdue 0, due-within-30-days 1, rest 2. Note: tab not visible in screenshots, judged from source.

items.item: Overdue or upcoming milestones are marked with a text label (such as "Overdue" or "Due in 5 days"), not by colour alone
items.evidence: milestoneStatus returns labels `Overdue ${n} days`, `Due in ${n} days`, 'Due today', 'Paid', 'Scheduled'; StatusBadge renders text plus icon.

items.item: The renewal or expiry date is shown as an absolute date with the remaining time stated in words (such as "Expires in 45 days")
items.evidence: Header badge 'Renewal notice due in 25 days' next to 'Renewal notice by 30/11/2026'; RenewalPanel banner 'Renewal notice is due in 25 days, by 30/11/2026 ... ends on 28/02/2027'. Expiry date itself has no day countdown, but the renewal deadline does.

items.item: Amendments are listed with number, date, a short summary and who approved them, using absolute dates
items.evidence: AmendmentsPanel columns Number (PL-01..), Effective date (dd/MM/yyyy), Summary, Value change, Status, Approval: 'Approved by Lê Thu Hà · 18/05/2026' or 'Waiting for Trần Minh Quân (Finance manager)'.

items.item: Each section has an empty state with a next action (such as "Add contact" or "Add amendment"), a loading state, and an inline error with retry
items.evidence: EmptyState with action button in Documents, Contacts ('Add contact'), Payments ('Add milestone'), Amendments ('Create amendment'), Renewal ('Set up renewal'), History. Loading: TableSkeleton per tab Section (aria-busy). Error: ErrorState role=alert with 'Retry' button (retry resets phase). Weak spots: states are page-level phases driven by ?state, History empty action is a no-op (onAction={() => undefined}) and the Terms field sections have no empty state.

items.item: Terminating the contract asks for confirmation that names the contract and the consequence, with a verb button label and focus not on the destructive button
items.evidence: AlertDialog title `Terminate contract ${id}?`, description names vendor, 60-day notice, unpaid milestones payable, pending amendment withdrawn; buttons 'Keep contract' (AlertDialogCancel, first in footer so it takes initial focus) and destructive 'Terminate contract'. Focus not verified at runtime.

notes: No template tells found: plain light page, no gradient/glass/emoji/KPI tiles/avatars/hover-lift; status badges are semantic with icon plus text, not decorative rainbow. Audit score 90: only violation is radius-scale (10px on the header '...' icon button, expected 8px or less). Font renders as Times New Roman in the screenshot (audit fontFamilies: times new roman), so the typeface looks unstyled/fallback, a visual weakness but not a checklist item. Only the Terms tab is visible in the first viewport; other tabs, loading, empty and error states were judged from source.
